title: Story premise EDU070: The Cabinet Door Needs Its Own Space
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: It fits when shut. Can it open? Takeaway/theme: A layout must account for movement and use, not just closed-object footprints.
description: A room planner wants a new storage unit to fit, but checks only the closed footprint and blocks its opening door. A swept-area overlay reveals the collision and a revised toy layout restores usable clearance.
